facts.fact: The authority issued a general directive requiring every data controller to appoint a Data Protection Officer and notify it by 30 May 2024; no decision on a named controller or count is given.

The notice states the Data Protection Act, 2022 designates the Eswatini Communications Commission as the Eswatini Data Protection Authority, which issues this directive; the notice is undated and 2024 is taken from its number.

note: carried from dataprotectionauthority, dataprotectionlaw; no document opened
